svg.title: Run 35, as its committed notes tell it
svg.desc: A vertical timeline of issue 35, which added a prompt cache and learned templates. Each event quotes a file in specs/35. The red notes show 31 of 33 golden tests failing on main. The builder first reported two blocked tests, then found they no longer reproduce and fixed the live spend cap. It added template-eval.ts, a file not on the plan, and the plan-drift check failed. The plan was updated to list the file. The CI stage could not reach a job log because gh was not logged in, and said so.
svg.text: Run 35: prompt cache and learned templates
Every line below is quoted from a file in specs/35/. The run log itself is gitignored.
Gherkin scenarios, each mapped to a golden test in red.md
"Checked on main ... 31 of 33 fail, 2 pass." The 2 are guards, so "the red check must run with ref: base".
"Blocked: two locked tests cannot pass as written." The builder proposes changing a locked test.
The blockers "no longer reproduce". The real failure: "/chat never read LIVE_SPENT_USD". Fixed.
Added api/src/agent/template-eval.ts, "not on the plan's file list".
check plan-drift FAIL: files outside plan.md: api/src/agent/template-eval.ts
"Plan drift fixed." plan.md now lists template-eval.ts "(line 16)". No source change.
"No CI job log was reachable: gh is not authenticated." It asks a person to confirm on a real runner.
